title: Machine Learning
blurb: Supervised and unsupervised learning, evaluation, feature engineering and deep learning with PyTorch, with runnable code.

quiz.question: Training error is low and validation error is high. What is happening?
options: The learning rate is too low
quiz.explanation: The model fits noise in the training set; regularise, simplify or add data.

quiz.question: Which is an example of data leakage when predicting order cancellation?
options: Using a refund_issued column that is set after cancellation
quiz.explanation: Features unavailable at prediction time inflate offline metrics and fail in production.

quiz.question: For tabular business data, which model family is usually the strongest default?
quiz.explanation: Boosted trees handle mixed features, interactions and missing values with modest tuning.

quiz.question: With 0.5% positives, which metric is most informative?
options: PR AUC / precision-recall at the operating threshold
quiz.explanation: Accuracy is misleading on imbalanced data; precision-recall reflects rare-class performance.

quiz.question: What does k-means require before fitting numeric features with very different ranges?
quiz.explanation: k-means uses Euclidean distance, so large-range features would dominate.

quiz.question: What does self-attention compute for each token?
options: A weighted mix of all tokens' values, weighted by query–key similarity
quiz.explanation: softmax(QKᵀ/√d)·V lets every token draw on relevant context anywhere in the sequence.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of model.eval() in PyTorch?
options: Switches layers like Dropout and BatchNorm to inference behaviour
quiz.explanation: Some layers behave differently in training and inference.

problems.title: Predict delivery ETAs
problems.prompt: Build and evaluate an ETA model for a delivery app.
problems.solution: Time-based split, median baseline, scikit-learn Pipeline with preprocessing, LightGBM, MAE by city, error analysis, consider predicting a high quantile to avoid under-promising, retrain as prep times drift.

problems.title: Fix an over-optimistic fraud model
problems.prompt: A fraud model has 0.97 ROC AUC offline but poor precision live. Diagnose.
problems.solution: Check for entity leakage (group split by device/user), point-in-time feature correctness, evaluate PR AUC and precision at the review team's capacity, calibrate, slice by segment, then monitor live.
